usage: deskops review status [-h] [--root ROOT] [--format {text,json,yaml}]
                             [target]

Compare current inputs with recorded reviews without calling the model.

positional arguments:
  target                Task selector or plan directory; omit to list every
                        key that has a review.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --format {text,json,yaml}
                        Output format.

Example:
  deskops review status task-fix-thing --root .
  deskops review status desk/drawer/plans/gates-por-tipo --root .
